dogecoin.text:
Do you wonder why #Dogecoin was named such? 
It was designed to be a friendly, more approachable form of #cryptocurrency that could reach users. 

Do you agree it has reached there?

#Dogecoin stands in the top 10 digital currencies today.
One can now perform SIP in the star coin via dApp which is a completely decentralized app giving you the freedom to be your own bank with transparency. 👀

#Dogecoin is a #cryptocurrency based on the "Doge" meme, which rose to popularity in late 2013. 
Defying all odds, its worth is $40 billion today, risen by a whopping 400% in the last seven days. 🔥
